what: Ordinance O-2 sets out the uses allowed by special use permit in the Rural Business zoning district. The list includes telecom antennas attached to existing structures, along with offices, vet hospitals, restaurants and others. The agenda doesn't say what is new in the list.

what: Crown Property Holdings, LLC asks to rezone 1775 Bald Hill Road, owned by Link Commercial Properties, LLC, from Office to General Business, with a special use permit (by City Council waiver or Unified Development Review) to use the property for 3D printing.

line: 1775 Bald Hill Road: zone change to General Business for a 3D printing shop, hearing
quote: The applicant is requesting a Zone Change from Office to General Business, along with a Special Use Permit by the way of a City Council Waiver through the Zone Change process or by the Unified Development Review to utilize the property for 3D printing under the use code 806 of the City of Warwick Zoning Ordinance.

what: Amendments to the zoning ordinance's 'Permitted Uses' (17.14.020) and to section 17.65's use regulations and dimensional requirements (17.65.020, 17.65.030), with the Planning Board's recommendation; our Oct 5 Planning Board record ties these to a new Waterfront Campus subdistrict in the Innovation Hub district and the rezoning of Plat 9, Lot 219 (item 2 on this agenda).
next: This is a 'First Reading'; the agenda doesn't say when the final vote is.
